affiliations.date_precision: A Packard collection item places Serge Daniloff in Japan-related company activity in 1936; a contemporary newspaper identifies him as regional manager in December 1937. Start and end dates are unknown.
affiliations.research_notes: The distinctive exact name, generation, surname history, automobile-industry context, and 1936-1937 chronology support a probable match. No source directly bridges the public biography to Box 166 or establishes that Packard was immediately before OSS.

affiliations.date_precision: In a May 1944 OSS interview, Daniluck described his civilian-life work as mail clerk and said he entered the Army on 22 August 1942. Employer and start date are not stated.

affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation value 137 was recorded at Army entry on 20 August 1942. NARA's code table defines 1-37 as Stenographers and typists; it does not distinguish the two or identify an employer.

affiliations.date_precision: A contemporary December 1940 newspaper names Richard Ely Danielson as associate editor in Boston; the NYPL finding aid describes him as company president and associate editor. Exact start and end dates are not stated.
affiliations.research_notes: The full-name expansion and publication career apply to Richard Ely Danielson. Their application to the index record remains probable because Box 166 has not been reviewed; no Atlantic-to-OSS transition is inferred.
